items.source: Returns the appropriate IdValueSource for the instance: NONE when the entity has no id property, PROVIDED when the value of the id property is not null and when it is a primitive type, not zero, and GENERATED otherwise.
items.translation: 返回适用于该实例的适当IdValueSource：当实体没有 id 属性时返回NONE；当 id 属性的值不为 null 且为基本类型（非零）时返回PROVIDED；否则返回GENERATED。

items.source: The id value is generated by the store.
There is no id property, and therefore no id value source.
items.translation: 不存在 id 属性，因此也没有 id 值源。

items.source: The id value is provided on the instance.
items.translation: 实例上提供了 id 值。
